messages:
Oncall Bot: paging: primary for this weekend (Sat‑Sun) marked OOO — auto-notice triggered 2464812345. Please confirm handoff or volunteer for primary/secondary.

Maria Gomez: wow last minute — I'm +0 for triage but I'm on travel until 2200 PST Saturday, can't take full primary. Can do overlap Friday night for warm handoff. :wave:

Samir Patel: I can pick up primary for the weekend if nobody objects. I'm on APAC-friendly hours and can cover the peak EU morning handoffs. Will be reachable on phone.

Jess Liu: thanks Samir. Quick Q — is there any active incident state we should be aware of or is this purely coverage gap?

Oncall Bot: no active P0s. There was a transient 503 spike on /v1/generate earlier but auto-retries cleared it; monitoring flagged but currently green. See logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/alerts/2464809999

Tom O'Neill: I'm out Sat morning CET but can act as secondary on Sat evening into Sun morning (CET->PST overlap). I can also handle quick customer callbacks if needed.

Maria Gomez: runbook pointer for the weekend folks — follow the "Weekend Triage" runbook, check the L7 fallback policy and model-fallback list. Important snippets: 

```
# Quick escalation commands (internal)
redwood-cli incidents list --open
redwood-cli incidents take --id <INCIDENT_ID> --assignee samir
# To trigger fallback routing to cheaper variant
curl -X POST https://api.internal/redwood/fallbacks -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"gpt-medium-qa"}'
```

Also check the console -> Model Catalog -> Fallbacks for the exact variant names.

Samir Patel: noted. I'll do a short walkthrough with Maria at 2100 PST tonight for handoff and then take primary at 0000 PST. Can someone add me to the weekend pager policy? I think SRE Rotation Bot still has last week's assignment.

SRE Rotation Bot: assignment update: removed previous primary tag for 2464812345; assigned Samir Patel as primary for 2464812345-2464898745. Secondary pending (Tom O'Neill indicated availability).

Jess Liu: Samir — FYI for customer impact: if you see sustained token latency >500ms with error rate >1% for 5m, follow post-checklist in the runbook and escalate to Eng Runtime oncall (eng-runtime channel) — there's a one‑click bridge link in the runbook.

Tom O'Neill: I can be secondary — confirm in thread and I'll stand by. Also I have the phone number for Enterprise Customer X if we need direct escalation.

Maria Gomez: confirmed. Samir primary, Tom secondary. I'll do the warm handoff tonight and drop the handoff notes here after the call (short checklist: keys rotated? KMS ok? any scheduled infra jobs?).

Samir Patel: thanks all. One last ask — can someone paste the short checklist for post-incident customer touching (what to say to support and what not to promise)? I want to prep responses.

Jess Liu: paste from support playbook: 
- Acknowledge receipt and impact window estimate.
- Confirm we have a mit plan and that engineers are on it.
- Do NOT promise ETA; provide rolling updates every 30m.
- If it's a config or model-fallback, offer the temporary routing change and note potential quality differences.

Maria Gomez: adding my handoff notes after the call: 
- No active incidents. 
- Short run-through with Samir at 2100 PST. 
- Confirmed contact list for Enterprise Customer X (Tom). 
- Verified playbooks and runbook links in thread. 

Samir Patel: got it, thanks Maria. I'll drop a short status ping every 2 hours on eng-oncall and escalate if anything trends.

Tom O'Neill: good luck, ping me if you need primary takeover. :thumbsup:

Oncall Bot: reminder scheduled: Samir Patel will be primary starting 2464812600. Secondary: Tom O'Neill.

Maria Gomez: closing the loop — everyone marked in rotation. Have a good weekend, stay safe.
